notes: REF-BM-02: only <title> is fetched (titleService.js); description, favicon, and preview image are never collected (bookmark object only has id/url/host/title/needsTitle/tags/createdAt). REF-BM-03: title can only be renamed via the 'add a name' button, which only appears when needsTitle is true (fetch failed); when the title fetch succeeds there is no rename affordance at all, no pre-save edit step, and no description field exists to edit. REF-BM-04: store.update() only accepts title and tags fields — url, description, and note are not editable, and title/tags edits are themselves gated (title only if needsTitle; tags only during the ephemeral 'fresh' post-save prompt, which disappears on skip or page reload). REF-BM-07: list items show tags and a placeholder letter-avatar (not a real favicon) and title/host; no description is rendered anywhere. REF-BM-09: tags can only be assigned during the one-time 'fresh' prompt shown immediately after saving (app.js renderItem/isFresh); once that prompt is closed or the page reloads, there is no UI to add tags to that or any other existing bookmark. REF-BM-12: matchesQuery() (shared.js) only checks title and host substrings — description, note, and full url path/query are not searched (and note/description don't exist as fields). REF-BM-14/15/16: search is a single case-insensitive substring match with no '#tag' token, no AND/OR/NOT/parenthesis parsing, and no quoted-phrase handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read flag exists on the bookmark model or API. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/endpoints exist (API only supports single-id PATCH/DELETE). REF-BM-22: bookmarks are always returned/rendered in storage order (newest-first via unshift); no alternate sort key is offered. REF-BM-23..32: no note/markdown, snapshot (HTML or PDF), Internet Archive integration, archive concept (only hard delete with a client-side undo timer), bundles, or Netscape import/export exist anywhere in the codebase.
